chunks: Whatever is in it from Safwan ibn Yahya, I have narrated it from my father—may Allah be pleased with him—from Ali ibn Ibrahim ibn Hashim, from his father, from Safwan ibn Yahya.
ai.seo_question: What is the transmission chain of Shaykh al-Saduq to Safwan ibn Yahya in Man La Yahduruhu al-Faqih?
ai.summary: This passage clarifies the sanad/isnad by which the author transmits reports from Safwan ibn Yahya in this book. It identifies the specific chain through the author's father, then Ali ibn Ibrahim ibn Hashim, then his father, back to Safwan ibn Yahya.
